name: Final Cleanup
description: Deletes data related to the currently processed video: recording data (video file, preview image, and meta record — deleted together as a single unit) and cache files (leftover same-named temp files left by other modules, deleted by default)

delete_recording_data.label: Delete recording data (video file + preview image + meta record)

delete_tmp_files.label: Delete cache files (leftover temp files from other modules)
